4 AH (ONLY 4 AH total across all 40 employees on Day 3!)\n# Poisson(6.2) = 9, 6, 4 -> sum = 19 vs expected 18.6! Totally matches!\n# And e15 got 1 AH (Poisson(3.3) = 1 has prob 12%, completely normal!).\n\n# Compute Bayesian posterior for each suspect m != decoy\n# 1. Prior: uniform over 39 non-decoy employees\n# 2. Canary c1 leaked with variant v1 (surfaced day 4):\n#    Only recipients of c1 can leak c1!\n#    Wait: let's also weight by P(c1 leaked on D1 or D2 and surfaced D4, and no D1 leak surfaced D3 | m, default random mole):\n#    On Day 1, EVERY recipient of c1 held ONLY c1!\n#    Wait: verify! Did ANY recipient of c1 receive d1-1 or d1-2?\n#    NO! c1 was given EXCLUSIVELY to ESR employees, and d1-1/d1-2 went EXCLUSIVELY to FL employees!\n#    So on Day 1, ALL 20 non-decoy recipients of c1 had IDENTICAL Day 1 leak probability (0.65)!\n#    What about Day 2 (if Day 1 didn't leak, prob 0.35, and Day 2 leaked c1 with delay=2, prob 0.5)?\n#    Let's compute exact default-mole Day 1 + Day 2 leak likelihood for each c1 recipient!\n\ndef pois_pmf(k, lam):\n    return (lam ** k) * math.exp(-lam) / math.factorial(k)\n\n# Count daytime and after-hours accesses per employee over 3 closed days:\n# For mole:\n#   daytime ~ Poisson(3 * 0.7 = 2.1)\n#   after_hours ~ Poisson(3 * 0.3 = 0.9)  [mole NEVER gets framed!]\n# For ordinary innocent (not mole, not decoy):\n#   daytime ~ Poisson(3 * 0.9 = 2.7)\n#   after_hours ~ Poisson(3 * (0.1 + 2.0 * 0.5 / 38)) = Poisson(3 * 0.1263 = 0.379)\n#   (or if mole has extra DSL random-colleague framing: 0.1 + 1.0/38 + 1.0/38 = 0.1526 -> 3*0.1526 = 0.458)\n\nday_cnt = Counter()\nah_cnt = Counter()\nfor l in all_logs:\n    if l[\"after_hours\"]:\n        ah_cnt[l[\"employee\"]] += 1\n    else:\n        day_cnt[l[\"employee\"]] += 1\n\nc1_doc = doc_map[\"c1\"]\nscores = {}\nfor e in employees:\n    eid = e[\"id\"]\n    if eid == decoy:\n        scores[eid] = 0.0\n        continue\n    if eid not in c1_doc[\"recipients\"]:\n        scores[eid] = 0.0\n        continue\n    # Variant likelihood for c1 -> v1\n    p_var = 0.95 if eid in c1_doc[\"variants\"][\"v1\"] else 0.025\n\n    # Day 1 + Day 2 leak dynamics (under default careful random mole)\n    # Day 1: holds only c1 -> leaks c1 w/ prob 0.65.\n    #   delay=2 (surfaces D3, DID NOT HAPPEN): 0.65 * 0.5 = 0.325\n    #   delay=3 (surfaces D4, HAPPENED!): 0.65 * 0.5 = 0.325\n    #   no leak D1: 0.35. Then on Day 2, holds c1 (w = 19/40 = 0.475) + d2 docs + c2/c2-2:\n    w_c1 = 1.0 - 21/40.0\n    w_tot_d2 = w_c1\n    for d in docs:\n        if d[\"day\"] == 2 and eid in d[\"recipients\"]:\n            if d[\"is_canary\"]:\n                w_tot_d2 += (1.0 - len(d[\"recipients\"]) / 40.0)\n            else:\n                w_tot_d2 += 1.0\n    p_leak_c1_d2_surf_d4 = 0.35 * 0.65 * (w_c1 / w_tot_d2) * 0.5\n    p_leak_obs = 0.325 + p_leak_c1_d2_surf_d4\n\n    # Access log likelihood ratio: P(logs_eid | eid is mole) / P(logs_eid | eid is ordinary innocent)\n    k_day = day_cnt[eid]\n    k_ah = ah_cnt[eid]\n    lr_day = pois_pmf(k_day, 2.1) / pois_pmf(k_day, 2.7)\n    lr_ah = pois_pmf(k_ah, 0.9) / pois_pmf(k_ah, 0.379)\n\n    # Interview LR\n    lr_int = 1.0\n    for ie, evasive in interviews:\n        if ie == eid:\n            lr_int *= (0.24 / 0.20) if evasive else (0.76 / 0.80)\n\n    scores[eid] = p_var * p_leak_obs * lr_day * lr_ah * lr_int\n\ntot_s = sum(scores.values())\npost = {k: v / tot_s for k, v in scores.items()}\nfor eid, p in sorted(post.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:15]:\n    # find d2 bucket\n    d2b = \"none\"\n    for cid in [\"c2\", \"c2-2\"]:\n        for v, lst in doc_map[cid][\"variants\"].items():\n            if eid in lst:\n                d2b = f\"{cid}:{v}\"\n    print(f\"{eid} ({emp_map[eid]['dept']:11s}, clr={emp_map[eid]['clearance']}): post={p:.4f} | day={day_cnt[eid]} AH={ah_cnt[eid]} | d2={d2b}\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/bayes_day4.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/bayes_day4.py","time":{"start":1794720540878,"end":1794720540884}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1ddae28c9001W2sIIV3UouO6py","sessionID":"ses_e225ce07cffeiYQrL2TrfYc9yz","messageID":"msg_1ddacf771001pcmSpa6JkIAoJq"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794720720354,"sessionID":"ses_e225ce07cffeiYQrL2TrfYc9yz","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"04ujeiP31Rohvrhi","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import math\nfrom collections import Counter\n\n# Let's check exact data for the ONLY 3 employees in the entire company who received c1, c2-2, AND d3-2!\n# First, double-check from raw doc recipient lists that NO OTHER EMPLOYEE received all 3!\nc1 = set([\"e00\", \"e02\", \"e04\", \"e07\", \"e08\", \"e10\", \"e13\", \"e14\", \"e15\", \"e17\", \"e19\", \"e21\", \"e22\", \"e25\", \"e26\", \"e27\", \"e28\", \"e30\", \"e31\", \"e33\", \"e38\"])\nc2_2 = set([\"e03\", \"e04\", \"e07\", \"e09\", \"e10\", \"e11\", \"e12\", \"e13\", \"e14\", \"e16\", \"e17\", \"e18\", \"e22\", \"e23\", \"e26\", \"e28\", \"e31\", \"e32\", \"e33\", \"e34\", \"e38\", \"e39\"])\nd3_2 = set([\"e02\", \"e03\", \"e11\", \"e14\", \"e18\", \"e20\", \"e21\", \"e22\", \"e24\", \"e29\", \"e34\", \"e35\", \"e36\", \"e37\", \"e38\"])\n\ncand = sorted(c1 & c2_2 & d3_2)\nprint(\"EXACT deterministic intersection c1 & c2-2 & d3-2:\", cand)\n\n# Logs across Days 1-4 for e14, e22, e38 (and decoy e15):\n# Day 1: e14: 1 day; e22: 2 AH; e38: 1 day; e15: 2 day\n# Day 2: e14: 2 day; e22: 1 day; e38: 1 day; e15: 2 day, 1 AH\n# Day 3: e14: 1 AH;  e22: 1 AH;  e38: 0;     e15: 1 day\n# Day 4: e14: 1 day; e22: 0;     e38: 2 day; e15: 2 AH\n\nstats = {\n    \"e14\": {\"day\": 4, \"ah\": 1, \"c1_v\": \"v1\", \"c22_v\": \"v1\", \"int_direct\": 1, \"int_evasive\": 0},\n    \"e22\": {\"day\": 1, \"ah\": 3, \"c1_v\": \"v2\", \"c22_v\": \"v1\", \"int_direct\": 1, \"int_evasive\": 0},\n    \"e38\": {\"day\": 4, \"ah\": 0, \"c1_v\": \"v3\", \"c22_v\": \"v3\", \"int_direct\": 0, \"int_evasive\": 0},\n}\n\ndef pois(k, lam):\n    return (lam ** k) * math.exp(-lam) / math.factorial(k)\n\n# For 4 closed days:\n# Mole:\n#   day ~ Poisson(4 * 0.7 = 2.8)\n#   ah  ~ Poisson(4 * 0.3 = 1.2)\n# Innocent (not mole, not decoy):\n#   day ~ Poisson(4 * 0.9 = 3.6)\n#   ah  ~ Poisson(4 * (0.1 + 1.0/38)) = Poisson(0.5053)  [default framing]\n#   OR if Mole DSL also frames random_colleague on matching days (up to +1/day -> +4/38):\n#   ah  ~ Poisson(0.5053 + 4/38 = 0.6105)\n\nfor mode, lam_inn_ah in [(\"default_framing\", 4 * (0.1 + 1.0/38)), (\"extra_random_framing\", 4 * (0.1 + 2.0/38))]:\n    print(f\"\\n--- Mode: {mode} ---\")\n    unnorm = {}\n    for eid, s in stats.items():\n        p_c1 = 0.95 if s[\"c1_v\"] == \"v1\" else 0.025\n        p_c22 = 0.95 if s[\"c22_v\"] == \"v1\" else 0.025\n        # Notice on Days 1, 2, 3, e14, e22, e38 received the EXACT SAME documents:\n        # Day 1: ONLY c1!\n        # Day 2: ONLY c2-2!\n        # Day 3: ONLY d3-1, d3-2, d3-3!\n        # So P(leak sequence c1 on D1, c2-2 on D2, d3-2 on D3) is 100.000% IDENTICAL for e14, e22, and e38!!\n        lr_day = pois(s[\"day\"], 2.8) / pois(s[\"day\"], 3.6)\n        lr_ah = pois(s[\"ah\"], 1.2) / pois(s[\"ah\"], lam_inn_ah)\n        lr_int = ((0.76 / 0.80) ** s[\"int_direct\"]) * ((0.24 / 0.20) ** s[\"int_evasive\"])\n        unnorm[eid] = p_c1 * p_c22 * lr_day * lr_ah * lr_int\n    Z = sum(unnorm.values())\n    for eid in cand:\n        print(f\"  {eid}: P = {unnorm[eid]/Z:.6f}\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/exact_day5.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/exact_day5.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/exact_day5.py","time":{"start":1794720720348,"end":1794720720353}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1ddb0e5d8001Wi6rjk28OUgsKn","sessionID":"ses_e225ce07cffeiYQrL2TrfYc9yz","messageID":"msg_1ddafd6cf001Nx5e394I4M8ds9"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794721000138,"sessionID":"ses_e225ce07cffeiYQrL2TrfYc9yz","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"PXXaORytxWUHFztq","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"python3 -c '\nimport math\ndef pois(k, lam): return (lam**k)*math.exp(-lam)/math.factorial(k)\n# 7 closed days:\n# e14: day=4, ah=3 (D3, D5, D7), evasive=2, direct=7; variants: v1, v1, v1 (3/3 matches!)\n# e22: day=2, ah=4 (D1x2, D3, D5), evasive=1, direct=8; variants: v2, v1, v2 (1/3 matches!)\n# e38: day=7, ah=1 (D5), evasive=0, direct=0; variants: v3, v3, v1 (1/3 matches!)\ndata = {\n  \"e14\": (4, 3, 2, 7, 3),\n  \"e22\": (2, 4, 1, 8, 1),\n  \"e38\": (7, 1, 0, 0, 1),\n}\nu = {}\nfor k, (d, ah, ev, dr, vm) in data.items():\n  p_v = (0.95**vm) * (0.025**(3-vm))\n  lr_d = pois(d, 7*0.7) / pois(d, 7*0.9)\n  lr_ah = pois(ah, 7*0.3) / pois(ah, 7*(0.1 + 1/38))\n  lr_i = ((0.24/0.20)**ev) * ((0.76/0.80)**dr)\n  u[k] = p_v * lr_d * lr_ah * lr_i\nZ = sum(u.values())\nfor k in data: print(k, f\"{u[k]/Z:.8f}\")\n'"},"output":"e14 0.99779501\ne22 0.00214768\ne38 0.00005732\n","metadata":{"output":"e14 0.99779501\ne22 0.00214768\ne38 0.00005732\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"python3 -c '\nimport math\ndef pois(k, lam): return (lam**k)*math.exp(-lam)/math.factorial(k)\n# 7 closed days:\n# e14: day=4, ah=3 (D3, D5, D7), evasive=2, direct=7; variants: v1, v1, v1 (3/3 matches!)\n# e22: day=2, ah=4 (D1x2, D3, D5), evasive=1, direct=8; variants: v2, v1, v2 (1/3 matches!)\n# e38: day=7, ah=1 (D5), evasive=0, direct=0; variants: v3, v3, v1 (1/3 matches!)\ndata = {\n  \"e14\": (4, 3, 2, 7, 3),\n  \"e22\": (2, 4, 1, 8, 1),\n  \"e38\": (7, 1, 0, 0, 1),\n}\nu = {}\nfor k, (d, ah, ev, dr, vm) in data.items():\n  p_v = (0.95**vm) * (0.025**(3-vm))\n  lr_d = pois(d, 7*0.7) / pois(d, 7*0.9)\n  lr_ah = pois(ah, 7*0.3) / pois(ah, 7*(0.1 + 1/38))\n  lr_i = ((0.24/0.20)**ev) * ((0.76/0.80)**dr)\n  u[k] = p_v * lr_d * lr_ah * lr_i\nZ = sum(u.values())\nfor k in data: print(k, f\"{u[k]/Z:.8f}\")\n'","time":{"start":1794721000089,"end":1794721000136}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1ddb52a88001JRhy17Jn6VDiXY","sessionID":"ses_e225ce07cffeiYQrL2TrfYc9yz","messageID":"msg_1ddb45db5001eRG3AQ0h97IWGl"}}
